say:1:1210201001:0.text: I can't believe that blasted innkeeper took Chippy hostage!
say:1:1210201001:0.source_cn: 那个蛮横的家伙！竟然把满满扣下当人质！

say:2:1210201002:0.text: How could Sinbad take us to an inn like that?! We don't even know where to find the damedangler right now!
say:2:1210201002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达也真是的，居然把我们带来这样的店里。我们现在连去...

choice_prompt:3:1210201002.text: How could Sinbad take us to an inn like that?! We don't even know where to find the damedangler right now!
choice_prompt:3:1210201002.source_cn: 辛巴达也真是的，居然把我们带来这样的店里。我们现在连去哪钓冥湾美人都不知道！

say:4:1210201003:0.source_cn: 对，让他给我们一个合理的解释！

choice:3:0:1.text: Sinbad needs to take care of this.
choice:3:0:1.male: Sinbad needs to take care of this.
choice:3:0:1.female: Sinbad needs to take care of this.

say:2:1210203001:1.source_cn: 我第一次见魔法师打架……简直神奇！这就是魔法师的力量吗？
say:2:1210203001:1.male: That's the first time I've ever seen a mage fight... That was amazing! Are you all like that?

say:4:1210203002:1.male: Does that mean I saved someone really important?
say:4:1210203002:1.female: Does that mean I saved someone really important?

say:5:1210203005:1.text: Sinbad, what happened? Why were those people after you? They even had their knives out.
say:5:1210203005:1.source_cn: 辛巴达不解释一下吗？那些人为什么围着你，连刀子都掏出来了？

say:6:1210203006:1.text: I just owe them money. You have to understand the locals are tough around here.
say:6:1210203006:1.source_cn: 嘿，不过就是欠了点钱，你们也知道，本地民风彪悍。

say:7:1210203007:1.text: Like how you tricked us into staying at that inn, and now Bols is keeping Chippy hostage!
say:7:1210203007:1.source_cn: ……民风彪悍指的是把我们骗进旅店，还扣下满满吗？！

say:8:1210203008:1.text: Huh? Wait, calm down. What happened to Chippy?
say:8:1210203008:1.source_cn: 啊？有事慢慢说，别着急，满满怎么了？
say:8:1210203008:1.male: Huh? Wait, calm down. What happened to Chippy?
say:8:1210203008:1.female: Huh? Wait, calm down. What happened to Chippy?

choice_prompt:9:1210203008.text: Huh? Wait, calm down. What happened to Chippy?
choice_prompt:9:1210203008.source_cn: 啊？有事慢慢说，别着急，满满怎么了？
choice_prompt:9:1210203008.male: Huh? Wait, calm down. What happened to Chippy?
choice_prompt:9:1210203008.female: Huh? Wait, calm down. What happened to Chippy?

say:10:1210203009:1.text: Bols said we owed him a lot of money. We couldn't pay so he kept Chippy hostage and told us to catch a fish in exchange.
say:10:1210203009:1.source_cn: 波尔斯管我们要钱，我们付不起，他就扣下了满满，要我们去...

say:11:1210203010:1.text: Didn't you say that Bols was your friend? Instead of taking care of us, he swindled us!
say:11:1210203010:1.source_cn: 你不是说波尔斯是你的朋友吗？结果他不仅不照顾我们，还——

say:12:1210203011:1.text: I didn't expect Bols to treat you like that. This is my fault. Don't worry, I'll help you. What kind of fish does he want in exchange?
say:12:1210203011:1.source_cn: ……没想到，波尔斯那老哥这么不厚道！这事怪我，别担心，...

say:13:1210203012:1.text: A damedangler. He said it was for the Carmine Whispers.
say:13:1210203012:1.source_cn: 冥湾美人。波尔斯说那是要上供给血薇帮的。

say:14:1210203013:1.text: Ah, it's for them... This won't be an easy job. That fish is big, mean, and tough. I guess that's why the Whispers' boss likes it.
say:14:1210203013:1.source_cn: 原来是要上贡的……那鱼可不好钓，又大又凶，偏偏血薇帮的...

say:15:1210203014:1.text: I'll take you to <style="highlight">Blackwood Loch</style>. You can only find damedanglers there.

say:16:1210203015:1.text: Alright, I'll go find a fishing rod. Let's <style="highlight">meet near Rustport's northwest gate</style>.
say:16:1210203015:1.source_cn: ……这样，我去找渔民摸根结实的鱼竿来，你们<style...

say:17:1210203016:1.text: You saved me just now, so the fishing rod is on me. Consider us even.
say:17:1210203016:1.source_cn: 你们刚才帮了我，就当我还个人情。

say:18:1210203017:0.text: I'll meet you <style="highlight">when the sun sets near the northwest wall</style>.

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 波尔斯的账单我们付不起

choice:9:2:3.text: You aren't working with Bols, right?
choice:9:2:3.male: You aren't working with Bols, right?
choice:9:2:3.female: You aren't working with Bols, right?

say:20:1210203003:1.text: You don't need to be modest with me. There used to be a lot of visitors to Rustport, and I've never seen a mage as powerful as you.

say:1:1210204002:0.female: At least he pointed us in the right direction.

say:1:1210206001:1.source_cn: 拿着，鱼竿找来了，鱼饵得你们自己找。

say:5:1210212001:0.text: Hey, what are you doing here?! This is a restricted area! No one is allowed to be here!
say:5:1210212001:0.source_cn: 喂，你们从哪来的？！这里是禁区，不得入内！

say:6:1210212002:1.text: This is a misunderstanding! Someone told us that we could catch damedanglers if we followed the road.
say:6:1210212002:1.source_cn: 一定是误会了！有人告诉我们沿着这条路走，可以钓到冥湾美人。

say:8:1210212004:0.text: Hey guys! We got a couple of <style="highlight">sea stingers</style> here!

say:9:1210212005:1.text: Sea stingers?! No, I'm just a hamster!
say:9:1210212005:1.source_cn: 海蝎子？不不不，我是仓鼠，仓鼠使魔！

say:10:1210212006:1.text: We know you're spies for the Water Wights! Don't try and run away!

narration:15:12010226:0.text: You are stopped by the patrol team of the Carmine Whispers while passing by the lumberyard.
narration:15:12010226:0.source_cn: 路过伐木场时，你们被血薇帮的巡查队拦了下来。
narration:15:12010226:0.male: You are stopped by the patrol team of the Carmine Whispers while passing by the lumberyard.

say:5:1210218002:1.text: There's a light on the top of its head, but...
say:5:1210218002:1.source_cn: 头顶有个灯瘤子，应该没错！但是……

say:5:1210218002:1.female: There's a light on the top of its head, but...

narration:11:12010235:0.source_cn: 主角钓到了力大无穷的冥湾美人，发现这鱼异常凶狠！
